intent: A modal that publishes selected project content — compositions, images, video, and audio — to the versioned project library, as a new item or a new version of an existing one.
guidance: Drive it fully controlled: entries, publishedItems, targetItemId, description, publishing, and error are all props, and it owns only the search query — every change emits through onEntryChange / onTargetItemChange / onDescriptionChange / onPublish (and optional onArchive / onRestore). Opening from a composition should arrive with that composition and its transitive media pre-selected; mark those entries required so the checkbox locks and the row reads "Required dependency". Choosing an existing item under "Publish as" makes the action a new version (v2, v3…), never an overwrite; the footer always states the count and whether it creates an item or a version. Set publishing to disable every control, withhold the close X, and suppress backdrop-click dismissal (closeOnBackdrop={!publishing}); note Escape still closes, because Modal wires onEscapeKeyDown unconditionally. Omit onArchive/onRestore to make published rows read-only.

anatomy.description: A 520px Modal card (bg-c-bg, rounded-c-lg, shadow-c-500 from Modal); backdrop dismissal is disabled while publishing (closeOnBackdrop={!publishing}).
ModalHeader title "Publish to project library" bound to the Radix DialogTitle, plus the close X — the X is withheld while publishing.
Fixed top zone (shrink-0, border-b border-c-border, 16px inset, 12px gap) holding the search, target select, and description.
InputField with a Search leading icon, placeholder "Search compositions and media"; filters the inventory by name and detail.
Native <select> (aria-label "Publish as") — "New library item · v1" or a non-archived published item's next version ("name · new vN").
Multiline InputField labeled "Version N description (optional)", placeholder "What changed in this version?".
Compositions / Images / Video / Audio, each an aria-labelled <section> with an uppercase 9px h3 heading; empty groups are omitted.
min-h-40 row (rounded-c-md, hover:bg-c-bg-hover): Checkbox + kind icon + name with a detail or "Required dependency" subtext; required entries lock the checkbox.
"No matching content" (h-96, centered) when the filter matches nothing.
Optional <section aria-label="Published items"> (border-t) listing a Library-icon row per item ("name · vN", archived rows tertiary) with an Archive / Restore action button.
role="alert" paragraph (border-t, text-c-text-danger) shown only when error is set.

ModalFooter align="between": left status "{count} selected · new vN / new item", right Cancel (Secondary) and Primary Publish button ("Publishing…" / "Publish {count}", disabled while publishing or at 0 selected).

use_when: Publishing project content to the versioned library: pick from a searchable, grouped inventory and confirm as a new item or a new version.
Managing existing library items alongside publishing — archive or restore them in the same surface (wire onArchive / onRestore).
dont_use_when: A blocking, destructive confirmation — use DeleteConfirmDialog.
A transient status message with an action — use a Notification toast.
Browsing or inserting already-published content — that is the Assets pane / New composition surface, not this publisher.
states: empty ("No matching content" when the filter matches nothing)
target: new item (v1) vs new version of an existing item (vN)
entry: required dependency (checkbox locked, "Required dependency" subtext)
published item: active (Archive) vs archived (Restore, tertiary text)
publishing (all controls disabled, close X withheld and backdrop-click dismissal suppressed — Escape still closes — button reads "Publishing…")

Dividers.borders: --color-border (border-b / border-t border-c-border on the setup block, published-items section, and error line)

Type.note: group headings and row text use hardcoded px sizes/weights (text-[11px]/[9px], font-[450]/[550], tracking-[0.05em] uppercase) rather than --composa-body-* type tokens

tokens.note: No #hex color in ProjectLibraryPublisher.tsx — every color binds to a c-* token. Geometry is hardcoded px for fidelity (width 520, max-h 560, insets 16/8, gaps 12/8/4, entry row min-h 40, published row min-h 36, select h-28, empty-state h-96, icons 12/14). Checkbox, Button, InputField, and Modal own their own token bindings; the modal backdrop scrim (rgba(0,0,0,0.4)) lives in Modal, not this component.

a11y.role: dialog — via Modal (Radix Dialog.Content supplies role=dialog + aria-modal, a focus trap, and Escape-to-close); the header title "Publish to project library" binds to the Radix DialogTitle for the accessible name.
a11y.close: The header X is a <button aria-label="Close"> (from ModalHeader) — withheld while publishing; a backdrop click also calls onClose but is suppressed while publishing (closeOnBackdrop={!publishing}); Escape always calls onClose via Modal's unconditional onEscapeKeyDown, even while publishing.
a11y.groups: Each kind group and the published-items block is a <section aria-label=…> (region landmark).
a11y.select: The target picker is a native <select aria-label="Publish as">.
a11y.entries: Each entry's Checkbox is role="checkbox" with aria-label "Add {name}" / "Remove {name}"; required entries disable it.
a11y.error: The error message is a role="alert" (assertive) live region.
a11y.note: publishing disables every control and withholds the close X; Publish is disabled at 0 selected. aria-describedby is intentionally undefined (from Modal).

code.example:
<ProjectLibraryPublisher
  open={open}
  entries={entries}
  publishedItems={publishedItems}
  targetItemId={targetId}
  description={description}
  publishing={publishing}
  error={error}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  onEntryChange={(id, selected) => toggleEntry(id, selected)}
  onTargetItemChange={setTargetId}
  onDescriptionChange={setDescription}
  onPublish={publish}
  onArchive={id => archive(id)}
  onRestore={id => restore(id)}
/>
